title: My meetings AI
hint:
Ask the AI about your meetings. It answers from every meeting you've joined that has a summary. Examples:
- What did we decide about attendance last week?
- What have Alice and I discussed recently?
- What were the customer's main requests?

Note: only meetings with a generated summary are indexed; new meetings appear within ~30 seconds after the meeting ends.
